## What and why / 做了什麼、為什麼

## Checks / 檢查
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes / 測試通過
- [ ] No videos, keyframes, hand-made scripts, keys or private names are included / 沒有附上影片、關鍵幀、人工腳本、金鑰或私人名稱
- [ ] User-visible text is in `lang/` (both `zh-TW.toml` and `en.toml`) / 使用者看得到的文字在語言包
- [ ] I agree my contribution is released under the project's license (see CONTRIBUTING.md) / 同意以專案授權釋出
